name: Comments
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; notes-on-a-record recurs across client repos, always re-implemented per model)
description: Comments and internal notes attachable to any model, with @mentions that fire an event rather than assuming a notification system. Threading is an install-time choice.

flat.label: Flat — one list, newest last. Simpler to read and to moderate. Replies still render if any exist; only the reply button is hidden

threaded.label: Threaded — one level of replies under each comment
